instruction: A small Roman terracotta oil lamp: a flattened rounded reservoir body with a central fill port on top, a projecting spout with a nozzle wick opening at the front, a small loop handle at the back, and a subtle decorative relief on the top disc.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a Roman oil lamp. A small Roman terracotta oil lamp: a flattened rounded reservoir body with a central fill port on top, a projecting spout with a nozzle wick opening at the front, a small loop handle at the back, and a subtle decorative relief on the top disc. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
